MINIO_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install MINIO. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise', 'asdf', 'pkgx', or 'vfox' defers to third-party tools.

MINIO_VERSION.description: Specific version of minio to install. Can be a numeric version or an alias.

MINIO_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading minio binary or archive artifacts.

MINIO_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying minio available remote releases.
